Preconditions: Assigned game link or app; internet on.
Steps: 1. Open the game. 2. Check whether the start screen loads.
Expected Result: The start screen appears; it is not blank, frozen or stuck loading.

Preconditions: Start screen visible.
Steps: 1. Open the menu icon. 2. Close it. 3. Repeat once.
Expected Result: The menu opens and closes; the start screen can still be used.

Preconditions: Solo: start screen. Local multiplayer: 2 connected controllers and 2 entered names; click outside the name box.
Steps: 1. Release all buttons. 2. Click or tap Play once. 3. Check that the countdown reaches GO.
Expected Result: One race loads and one countdown reaches GO; each joined player has a usable view.

Preconditions: Race has reached GO; use the controls in the quick guide.
Steps: 1. Accelerate. 2. Steer left then right. 3. Brake or turn off touch acceleration.
Expected Result: Each player's kart responds to their own controls; play can continue.

Preconditions: Race running.
Steps: 1. Follow the road for 2 full laps. 2. In multiplayer, have every player finish.
Expected Result: Every player can finish; nobody remains racing after completing both laps correctly.

Preconditions: All human racers finished.
Steps: 1. Look at the results after finishing. 2. Read each player's name and total time.
Expected Result: Results appear for every human racer with the correct name and a positive time; the game remains responsive.

Preconditions: Online; completed smoke race; name and time recorded.
Steps: 1. Open the leaderboard. 2. Solo: choose Today. Multiplayer: choose Multiplayer. 3. Find your result, scrolling if needed; use Retry if shown.
Expected Result: Your result appears under the correct name. Solo shows your best time today, which may be an earlier faster time; multiplayer shows this finish once. An error or endless loading is not a pass.

Preconditions: All racers finished; results visible.
Steps: 1. Select Retry Race (circular arrow); in multiplayer open the pause menu first. 2. Drive after GO.
Expected Result: A fresh race starts in the same mode with the same players and working controls.

Preconditions: Start screen; ready to race.
Steps: 1. Click or tap Play several times quickly. 2. Check that one race starts.
Expected Result: Only one race and one countdown start; no overlapping screens or sound.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Menu blocks the screen behind it
Preconditions: Start screen; ready to race.
Steps: 1. Open the menu. 2. Click where Play was behind it. 3. Close the menu.
Expected Result: No race starts behind the menu; Play works after closing it.

Preconditions: Start screen; online.
Steps: 1. Open the leaderboard. 2. Switch tabs. 3. Close it. 4. Start a race.
Expected Result: Closing returns to the start screen; the race starts normally.

Preconditions: Start screen.
Steps: 1. Open and close the menu 10 times. 2. Open and close the leaderboard 10 times.
Expected Result: No stacked windows, disappearing buttons or increasingly slow responses.

Preconditions: Start screen; device volume audible.
Steps: 1. Open the menu and mute sound. 2. Start a race. 3. Pause and turn sound back on; resume.
Expected Result: Game sound stays off while muted and returns when enabled; no doubled music.

Preconditions: Start screen; ready to race.
Steps: 1. Open and close the leaderboard. 2. Immediately select Play. 3. Finish the race.
Expected Result: No leaderboard remains over the race; results are reachable afterward.

Preconditions: Start screen.
Steps: 1. Leave the game open while you take a break of any length. 2. Return and start a race.
Expected Result: The game still accepts input and starts one race.

Preconditions: Race running; record current lap/time.
Steps: 1. Pause. 2. Select the exit-door icon to return to the start screen. 3. Start again.
Expected Result: The correct start screen returns; the next race starts from a new countdown and fresh timer.

Preconditions: Solo desktop race; clear road.
Steps: 1. Hold acceleration. 2. Tap left then right 3 times. 3. Release steering.
Expected Result: The kart turns in the requested direction without missed presses; releasing steering stops the commanded turn.

Preconditions: Keyboard or controller race; clear road.
Steps: 1. Accelerate on a clear road. 2. Release acceleration and hold brake until stopped. 3. Keep holding brake.
Expected Result: The kart slows, stops and then reverses; acceleration can move it forward again.

Preconditions: Keyboard or controller race; approaching a bend.
Steps: 1. Accelerate and steer into the bend. 2. Hold the drift control. 3. Release it.
Expected Result: Drifting visibly changes the turn; releasing returns to normal driving without stuck drift input.

Preconditions: Race running; visible road boost pad.
Steps: 1. Drive across the pad. 2. Steer through the next bend.
Expected Result: The boost increases pace and follows the kart's travel direction; steering still works.

Preconditions: Race running; a custard/slippery patch visible on the track.
Steps: 1. Drive through the patch. 2. Return to normal road and keep driving.
Expected Result: Grip changes on the patch and returns afterward; the kart is not permanently sliding.

Preconditions: Fresh race.
Steps: 1. Stay on the road for the full first lap. 2. Continue for the second lap.
Expected Result: The first lap advances progress without finishing; the second complete lap finishes the racer.

Preconditions: Race running near the finish line; no full lap completed yet.
Steps: 1. Cross the line. 2. Reverse across it. 3. Cross forward again without driving around the track.
Expected Result: Crossing back and forth does not award a completed lap or finish the race.

Preconditions: Starting a fresh race.
Steps: 1. Hold acceleration and steering during the countdown. 2. Release and press them again after GO.
Expected Result: The kart cannot race before GO; controls work after GO without a stuck input.

Preconditions: Race running; clear wall beside road.
Steps: 1. Drive into the wall. 2. Release acceleration. 3. Reverse and steer back onto the road.
Expected Result: You can free the kart and continue; it does not remain trapped inside the wall.

Preconditions: A reachable road edge where falling is possible. Skip if you cannot find one.
Steps: 1. Drive off the edge. 2. Check whether the kart returns to the road and you can continue. Stop this check whenever you prefer.
Expected Result: The kart returns to drivable road; no free lap is awarded and the race remains finishable.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Computer racers leave you able to finish
Preconditions: Solo race.
Steps: 1. Let a computer racer finish ahead of you. 2. Finish your own 2 laps.
Expected Result: Your race continues until you finish; results do not wrongly declare you the winner.

Preconditions: Solo with computer opponents or local multiplayer.
Steps: 1. Drive alongside another kart. 2. Make light side contact. 3. Separate and continue.
Expected Result: Contact does not trap either kart, launch it out of the level or make controls stop working.

Preconditions: Race running.
Steps: 1. Stop somewhere safe during the race. 2. Continue and finish when you want.
Expected Result: The race remains finishable; total time includes the unpaused stop.

Preconditions: Solo or multiplayer; tester has completed one practice race.
Steps: 1. Drive one more full race. 2. In Notes record pace: too fast / about right / too slow. 3. Record steering: prompt / delayed; give the bend or landmark and control used for any difficulty.
Expected Result: The full race can be driven without missed inputs or control freezes. Record balance preferences even on PASS; use FAIL for an observed control malfunction.

Preconditions: Keyboard or controller race; clear straight road.
Steps: 1. Hold Shift on keyboard or the top face button on controller. 2. Release it. 3. Repeat twice.
Expected Result: The camera looks behind while held and returns to the forward view on release; driving still works.

Preconditions: Solo race; minimap visible.
Steps: 1. Drive through two bends. 2. Watch your marker and nearby opponent markers.
Expected Result: Markers move with the racers; your marker is distinguishable and does not remain at the start while you move around the track.

Preconditions: Race running; note timer.
Steps: 1. Open pause and note the timer. 2. Check that it stays still. 3. Resume.
Expected Result: Karts and race timer stop during pause; the timer does not add the paused time when you resume.

Preconditions: Fresh race countdown.
Steps: 1. Pause during the countdown. 2. Check that it stays paused. 3. Resume.
Expected Result: The countdown resumes from where it paused; there is no hidden race start.

Preconditions: Race running.
Steps: 1. Pause and resume 5 times. 2. Drive, brake and steer.
Expected Result: The final state is playable; sound, timer and controls are not stuck paused.

Preconditions: Race running.
Steps: 1. Hold acceleration or steering. 2. Pause. 3. Release all controls. 4. Resume.
Expected Result: Released controls are not stuck on after resume; mobile automatic acceleration follows its visible toggle.

Preconditions: Race running; pause menu open.
Steps: 1. Open the leaderboard. 2. Close it. 3. Check that the race is still paused. 4. Select Resume.
Expected Result: Closing the leaderboard leaves the race paused until Resume is selected.

Preconditions: Solo; online; start screen name has loaded.
Steps: 1. Note the full assigned name including its number. 2. Finish a race. 3. Compare the name on results and leaderboard.
Expected Result: The same full name identifies your result throughout; it is not replaced by another player's name.

Preconditions: Solo; assigned name recorded; same browser profile or app.
Steps: 1. Reload or reopen the game. 2. Compare the name once it appears.
Expected Result: The assigned name remains the same, including its number.

Preconditions: Solo links on 2 separate normal browser profiles/devices; online.
Steps: 1. Record each assigned name. 2. Complete a race on each. 3. Find both on the leaderboard.
Expected Result: Each player's time belongs to their own full name; the two players do not overwrite each other.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 controllers joined.
Steps: 1. Give one player a name. 2. Leave the other name blank and attempt Play. 3. Enter only spaces and attempt Play again.
Expected Result: Neither blank nor spaces-only names allow the race to start.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 joined players; one name blank.
Steps: 1. Enter the missing name. 2. Click outside the name box. 3. Release controller buttons and click Play.
Expected Result: The corrected names allow the race to start and appear with the right players.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 players joined; second name valid.
Steps: 1. Paste ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ123456 into the first name box (32 characters). 2. Click outside and check Play. 3. Add 7 (33 characters) and check again.
Expected Result: The 32-character name is accepted. The extra character is prevented or Play is blocked until the name is valid.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 players joined.
Steps: 1. Enter Zoë O'Neil and José-2. 2. Start and finish a race. 3. Find both finishes on Multiplayer.
Expected Result: Both names remain readable and correctly assigned on results and the leaderboard.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 players joined.
Steps: 1. Name one player Alex and the other Sam. 2. Finish a race and view Multiplayer.
Expected Result: The first name appears literally as Alex; it does not become styled text or break the list.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 players joined.
Steps: 1. Enter Alex for both. 2. Finish at clearly different times. 3. Find the two new finishes on Multiplayer.
Expected Result: Both finishes are retained with their own times; neither is lost because the names match.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 players joined.
Steps: 1. Click the first name box and type Race One. 2. Press Tab and type Race Two. 3. Press Shift+Tab.
Expected Result: Text goes into the intended boxes; moving between boxes does not start a race or open a menu.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 players joined.
Steps: 1. Enter '  Alex  ' without quotation marks for one player and Sam for the other. 2. Finish a race and view Multiplayer.
Expected Result: The saved first name is Alex without leading/trailing spaces; the second player's name is unchanged.

Preconditions: Multiplayer start screen; only 1 controller joined with a name.
Steps: 1. Attempt Play. 2. Join a second controller and enter a second name. 3. Click outside the box; release buttons and click Play.
Expected Result: One player cannot start this mode; two named players can.

Preconditions: Multiplayer race with 2 players; note names and horse colours.
Steps: 1. Player 1 drives while Player 2 releases controls. 2. Swap roles. 3. Both drive together.
Expected Result: Each controller drives only its own kart; names, colours and screen areas stay with the correct player.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 3 physical controllers and testers.
Steps: 1. Join all 3 and enter distinct names. 2. Start a race. 3. Each player takes a turn steering.
Expected Result: All 3 views are usable; every controller and name belongs to the correct kart; no phantom fourth racer.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 4 physical controllers and testers.
Steps: 1. Join all 4 and enter distinct names. 2. Start and finish together.
Expected Result: All 4 players can race and read their own results without overlap or swapped views.

Preconditions: Multiplayer start screen; 2 controllers available.
Steps: 1. Press a join button 5 times on controller 1. 2. Join controller 2 once.
Expected Result: Exactly 2 players join; one controller does not create multiple players or start the race.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 4 joined players; spare fifth controller.
Steps: 1. Press buttons on the fifth controller. 2. Start with the original four.
Expected Result: No fifth racer is added and the original four keep their names and controls.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 3 named players joined.
Steps: 1. Disconnect the middle player's controller. 2. Attempt Play. 3. Reconnect that controller.
Expected Result: Play is blocked while a joined controller is missing; reconnect restores the same name and screen position.

Preconditions: Multiplayer race with 2 or more players.
Steps: 1. Disconnect one joined controller while driving. 2. Have another player try driving.
Expected Result: Everyone pauses; a disconnected-controller message appears; the other controller does not take over the missing kart.

Preconditions: MP-008 reached the disconnected-controller pause.
Steps: 1. Reconnect the missing controller. 2. Check that the race stays paused. 3. Select Resume. 4. Each player steers.
Expected Result: The game waits for explicit Resume; every controller regains its original kart, name and view.

Feature: [REGRESSION] First finisher does not end everyone
Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 racers; Player 2 deliberately behind.
Steps: 1. Player 1 finishes. 2. Player 2 keeps racing and finishes later.
Expected Result: Player 1 gets personal results in their view; Player 2 remains able to race until their own finish.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; one player finished and another still racing.
Steps: 1. Open pause. 2. Inspect Retry Race. 3. Resume and finish with everyone. 4. Open pause again.
Expected Result: Retry Race is unavailable until all racers finish, then becomes available.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; all players finished.
Steps: 1. Open pause and select Retry Race. 2. Each player drives briefly.
Expected Result: Names, colours, screen positions and controller ownership stay with the same players; the new timer starts fresh.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; return to start after a completed race.
Steps: 1. Select New Group. 2. Check every name box. 3. Enter new names and race.
Expected Result: Old names are cleared; the new race uses the new names without changing the joined controllers.

Preconditions: Multiplayer race.
Steps: 1. Two players press Start nearly together. 2. Release buttons. 3. Use the mouse to pause/resume if needed.
Expected Result: Only one shared pause menu exists; players can return to a working race without stacked windows.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Keyboard does not steal a kart
Preconditions: Multiplayer race; keyboard attached.
Steps: 1. Press W, A, S and D. 2. Press Esc, then Resume. 3. Use both controllers.
Expected Result: Keyboard driving does not move either kart; Esc opens pause and controller ownership stays unchanged.

Preconditions: Solo race; note the timer near the finish. A screenshot is optional.
Steps: 1. Complete 2 laps. 2. Read total time, both lap times and best lap.
Expected Result: Total agrees with the finish timer within 0.1 seconds; lap times sum to total within 0.1 seconds; best lap is the shorter lap.

Preconditions: Solo; a collectible visible on the track.
Steps: 1. Collect at least one item and finish. 2. Read PICKUPS.
Expected Result: PICKUPS is above zero; it belongs to this race, not the previous one.

Feature: One collision does not count forever
Preconditions: Solo race.
Steps: 1. Hit a wall firmly. 2. Hold against it briefly. 3. Finish while avoiding further impacts where possible.
Expected Result: CRASHES does not count every frame of the same sustained impact; compare the result with the separate impacts you noticed.

Preconditions: Solo; drift control, boost pad and custard patch identified.
Steps: 1. Drift through a bend, cross a boost pad and drive through custard. 2. Finish. 3. Read those statistics.
Expected Result: DRIFT, BOOST, CUSTARD, TOP SPEED and PADS are above zero; none shows a negative or missing value.

Preconditions: Results visible; note the displayed statistics.
Steps: 1. Watch the horse move after finishing. 2. Compare the displayed statistics before leaving the results.
Expected Result: Time, pickups, crashes and other race statistics are unchanged after finishing.

Preconditions: Completed solo race with pickups; record results.
Steps: 1. Retry. 2. Avoid pickups throughout the new race. 3. Finish.
Expected Result: PICKUPS shows zero for the new race; results do not reuse the previous race's counters.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Different multiplayer times stay with players
Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 distinct names; record finish order and both finish times.
Steps: 1. Finish several seconds apart. 2. Read both result panels and Multiplayer leaderboard.
Expected Result: Each name has its own time; the first finisher is 1st and the second is 2nd; neither receives the other's result.

Preconditions: Race running near the final finish line.
Steps: 1. Keep holding acceleration and steering as you cross the final finish line. 2. Release them on the results screen.
Expected Result: Results are not accidentally dismissed and no retry or menu action is activated by the held driving input.

Feature: Read results on all screen sizes
Preconditions: Results visible on assigned screen; use 4-player results for multiplayer.
Steps: 1. Read each name, time and statistic without changing the game layout.
Expected Result: All displayed values are legible and remain inside their player's area; no text covers another value.

Preconditions: Solo; first completed online race for this browser identity today; name/time recorded.
Steps: 1. Open Today and find your full name. 2. Open All Time and find it again.
Expected Result: Today shows this time once; All Time shows this time or your earlier faster best once. Both boards use your exact name.

Preconditions: Solo; best Today and All Time times recorded; same day and browser.
Steps: 1. Finish another race slower than both best times. 2. Open both boards.
Expected Result: The faster existing times remain; a second row is not added for this same player.

Preconditions: Solo; same browser; previous best recorded; tester able to beat it.
Steps: 1. Finish faster than your previous best. 2. Open Today and All Time.
Expected Result: Each board whose best was beaten shows the new faster time once and in the correct position.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Fastest times are at the top
Preconditions: Any populated leaderboard.
Steps: 1. Read 10 consecutive rows, scrolling if needed. 2. Compare times and ranks.
Expected Result: Times run from fastest to slowest; displayed ranks advance down the list. Equal times are allowed.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Scroll to more results and back
Preconditions: A board with more than 20 entries. Skip if none is available.
Steps: 1. Scroll past the first 20 results. 2. Note the names, times and ranks around rows 20-21. 3. Scroll up and down again.
Expected Result: Rows remain in order with no repeated or missing row at the join between loaded sections.

Preconditions: Online leaderboard.
Steps: 1. Select Today, All Time, Multiplayer, then Today quickly. 2. Check the loaded rows.
Expected Result: The title, selected tab and rows all belong to Today; a late reply does not replace them with another board.

Preconditions: Online; leaderboard about to open.
Steps: 1. Open the leaderboard and immediately close it. 2. Start a race or return to results. 3. Open it again.
Expected Result: No old leaderboard appears over gameplay; reopening shows a usable board.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Repeated viewing does not duplicate finish
Preconditions: Completed multiplayer race; record each name/time and count matching new rows.
Steps: 1. Open and close Multiplayer 5 times. 2. Reload the game and reopen it.
Expected Result: The same finish still appears once per player; viewing/reloading does not create extra rows.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; first race's names/times recorded.
Steps: 1. Retry with the same players and finish again at different times. 2. Open Multiplayer.
Expected Result: Both races remain: one record per player per completed race. Repeated names are expected.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Multiplayer does not enter solo boards
Preconditions: Multiplayer; record Today and All Time before racing; use distinct player names.
Steps: 1. Finish a multiplayer race. 2. Check all 3 boards.
Expected Result: The new named finishes appear in Multiplayer; they are not added to Today or All Time.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Abandoned race is not a finish
Preconditions: Solo or multiplayer; board noted before race.
Steps: 1. Start a race. 2. Return to the start screen before anyone finishes. 3. Open the relevant board.
Expected Result: No score is created for the unfinished race; existing completed scores remain.

Feature: [REGRESSION] Finished player survives early group exit
Preconditions: Multiplayer; Player 1 finished, Player 2 still racing; record Player 1 time.
Steps: 1. Pause and return to the start screen. 2. Open Multiplayer.
Expected Result: Player 1's completed finish is retained once; Player 2 has no finish for this race.

Preconditions: An empty board is available. Skip if all boards contain results; do not clear a board.
Steps: 1. Open the empty board. 2. Close it.
Expected Result: An understandable no-times message appears; no fake rows or endless loading; closing still works.

Preconditions: Completed online race; displayed leaderboard result recorded.
Steps: 1. Close the game normally. 2. Reopen the same link/app and browser profile. 3. Open the relevant board.
Expected Result: The completed score remains under the correct name; the restart does not add another copy.

Preconditions: Only if you happen to be playing across UK midnight; note Today and All Time beforehand. Otherwise skip.
Steps: 1. Reopen Today after midnight. 2. Compare it with the earlier view. 3. Check All Time.
Expected Result: Yesterday's Today scores are no longer presented as today's scores; All Time remains intact. Report an unavailable board separately from an empty board.

Preconditions: Only if a solo race happens to start before and finish after UK midnight. Otherwise skip.
Steps: 1. Record the finish time of day and race time. 2. Open Today after finishing.
Expected Result: The completed race belongs to the new day's Today board, under the correct player name.

Preconditions: Game loaded; a leaderboard tab you have not opened this session.
Steps: 1. Disconnect internet. 2. Open the unviewed board. 3. Check for an error, then close it whenever you want.
Expected Result: A connection/unavailable message replaces loading; you can close the board and still play.

Preconditions: Offline leaderboard showing an error.
Steps: 1. Restore internet. 2. Select Retry, or close and reopen the board. 3. Check whether results load.
Expected Result: Results load again without restarting the whole game; the selected board is correct.

Preconditions: Solo loaded online; assigned name recorded; same UK day.
Steps: 1. Disconnect internet. 2. Finish and note your result. 3. Restore internet and open Today/All Time; use Retry if shown.
Expected Result: Local results remain available offline. After reconnecting, each board shows this time or an earlier faster best under your name, once. If it is still pending when you stop, note that or choose Can’t test.

Preconditions: Solo loaded online; assigned name recorded; same day.
Steps: 1. Disconnect internet and finish. 2. View the results. 3. Restore internet and reload the same game and browser profile. 4. Check both boards.
Expected Result: The saved finish reaches both boards unless an earlier faster best exists; it is not lost or assigned to someone else.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 named players; game loaded online.
Steps: 1. Disconnect internet. 2. Have both players finish at different times and note the results. 3. Restore internet and open Multiplayer.
Expected Result: Both finishes appear once each with the correct names and times.

Preconditions: Multiplayer; 2 racers near finish; helper controls network.
Steps: 1. Disconnect internet as players finish. 2. Restore it after the results appear. 3. Open Multiplayer and use Retry if shown.
Expected Result: Both completed finishes eventually appear once; a lost reply does not cause duplicate rows.

Preconditions: Leaderboard error after connection loss; recorded completed finish.
Steps: 1. Restore internet. 2. Click Retry up to 5 times quickly while available. 3. Reopen the board.
Expected Result: The board recovers; the same finish is not duplicated and the screen remains usable.

Preconditions: Only if a solo offline finish happened before UK midnight and you reconnect after midnight. Otherwise skip.
Steps: 1. Reconnect after midnight. 2. Check Today and All Time.
Expected Result: Yesterday's finish does not enter the new Today board; All Time accepts it if it improves your best.

Preconditions: Solo race completed; results visible.
Steps: 1. Select the three-cards Highlights icon. 2. Swipe/drag horizontally or use left/right arrows through the cards.
Expected Result: Five race categories appear: finish, laps, speed/boost, drift/custard and pickups/crashes. World Standings is an optional sixth card. Available photos show this race without blank rendering.

Preconditions: Solo results noted; Highlights open.
Steps: 1. Compare time, laps, position, pickups and crashes across the cards with this race's results.
Expected Result: Every displayed race value agrees with the results; cards use your correct full name.

Preconditions: Highlights open.
Steps: 1. Click/tap a card to enlarge it. 2. Use the close/back icon once. 3. Use it again.
Expected Result: First action returns to the card collection; second returns to results; underlying buttons remain usable.

Preconditions: Solo browser build on phone; completed race; a private share destination of your choice.
Steps: 1. Select a card and tap Share. 2. If comfortable, send it to your private destination; otherwise skip sending. 3. Open the received or saved image, if you made one.
Expected Result: A readable image of the selected card arrives or saves, with correct name and values; no blank image or different card.

Preconditions: Solo browser build in browser without file-sharing support; completed race.
Steps: 1. Select a highlight and click Share. 2. Open the downloaded image or image preview.
Expected Result: A readable JPEG of the selected card can be saved; unsupported sharing does not freeze the game.

Preconditions: Phone/browser that opens a share chooser; Highlights open.
Steps: 1. Tap Share. 2. Cancel the chooser. 3. Browse another card and close Highlights.
Expected Result: Cancellation returns control to the game and does not unexpectedly send or download a card.

Preconditions: Highlights open; private destination of your choice or download fallback.
Steps: 1. Swipe rapidly through 3 cards. 2. Stop on a clearly different card. 3. Tap Share once enabled. 4. Open the resulting image.
Expected Result: The shared image matches the card selected at the time of sharing, not an earlier card.

Preconditions: Highlights open.
Steps: 1. Tap Share 5 times quickly. 2. Cancel any chooser, or inspect downloaded images. 3. Close Highlights.
Expected Result: The game recovers without frozen controls or invisible overlays; any produced images match the selected card. Record the number of prompts/files.

Preconditions: Solo finished race with highlights viewed; note time/photo.
Steps: 1. Retry and complete another race. 2. Open Highlights.
Expected Result: Cards show the new race's time, statistics and photos; the previous race is not reused.

Preconditions: Solo; online; earlier best recorded; completed slower race uploaded promptly; both Today and All Time contain your name.
Steps: 1. Open Highlights. 2. Find World Standings. 3. Compare its times and ranks to your recorded personal-best rows.
Expected Result: When both rankings are available, a sixth World Standings card shows personal bests, not necessarily this race. If it is missing on a healthy connection, you can note that; there is no need to keep waiting.

Preconditions: Solo; finish offline; do not restore internet.
Steps: 1. Open Highlights. 2. Browse the cards. 3. Close Highlights.
Expected Result: Five local race cards remain usable and closing works. World Standings is omitted when rankings could not be fetched; no ranking is invented.

Preconditions: Solo; same game session.
Steps: 1. Complete 5 races using Retry. 2. After each, open all cards and close Highlights 3 times.
Expected Result: No browser crash, disappearing images or progressively unusable slowdown; note where any slowdown begins.

Preconditions: Solo phone/tablet; landscape; fresh race.
Steps: 1. Let the countdown reach GO without holding acceleration. 2. Tap the acceleration button once. 3. Tap again.
Expected Result: Automatic acceleration starts at GO; first tap turns it off and second turns it on; visible state agrees with movement.

Preconditions: Solo phone/tablet race.
Steps: 1. Steer left then right while accelerating. 2. Use drift while steering. 3. Lift every finger except automatic acceleration remains enabled.
Expected Result: Each touch control responds independently; steering and drift do not stick when fingers lift.

Preconditions: Solo phone/tablet in landscape; timer visible.
Steps: 1. Turn the device upright during a race. 2. Turn it sideways again.
Expected Result: A rotate prompt blocks portrait racing; returning to landscape does not add the paused time or lose the controls.

Preconditions: Solo phone/tablet; pause menu open.
Steps: 1. Rotate upright then sideways. 2. Check that the game is still paused. 3. Select Resume.
Expected Result: Returning to landscape leaves the game paused until Resume is selected.

Preconditions: Solo phone; Highlights open.
Steps: 1. Enlarge a card. 2. Rotate upright then sideways. 3. Return to the collection and close it.
Expected Result: The enlarged card remains readable; controls stay reachable; returning to the race/results restores normal landscape behaviour.

Preconditions: Browser game; host offers a fullscreen control.
Steps: 1. Enter fullscreen. 2. During a race press Esc. 3. If only fullscreen closes, use Esc again or the solo pause icon.
Expected Result: You can reach pause and resume without losing input or leaving an invisible overlay; browser fullscreen exit alone is allowed.

Preconditions: Race running on assigned device.
Steps: 1. Switch to another tab/app. 2. Return when you want. 3. Release and press controls again.
Expected Result: The game remains usable without stuck steering, blank screen or duplicated audio. Record whether the race continued or paused; either is acceptable here.

Preconditions: Assigned smallest supported phone or desktop window.
Steps: 1. Visit start, pause, results and leaderboard. 2. In solo also open Highlights.
Expected Result: Text and buttons fit; names/times are readable; essential controls are not behind a notch or outside the screen.

Preconditions: Browser race running; board before race recorded.
Steps: 1. Reload the page halfway through the race. 2. Start a new race.
Expected Result: The start screen loads and the new race works; no completed result is submitted for the abandoned race. Mid-race resume is not expected.

Preconditions: Leaderboard website open; internet on.
